image_location_description: Bottom edge of image: character’s boots/feet

steps.title: Soles
steps.description: Place 2x White 3020 plates (2x4) side-by-side as left/right soles.

steps.title: Upper blocks
steps.description: Add 2x White 3021 plates (2x3) on top, aligned to the heel (toe overhang).

steps.title: Ankle rise
steps.description: Add 2x White 3022 plates (2x2) on the rear of each foot, centered.

steps.title: Toe step
steps.description: Add 2x LBG 3023 plates (1x2) on the front row of each foot.

steps.title: Rear connector
steps.description: Bridge inner rear studs with 1x LBG 3710 plate (1x4) to lock feet together.

steps.title: Front connector
steps.description: Bridge inner toe studs with 1x White 3710 plate (1x4) for stability.

steps.title: Mount studs
steps.description: Add 2x White 3024 plates (1x1) on the rear connector as attachment points.
